title: Quantity of hazardous materials.
officialText:
The aggregate quantity of nonflammable solid and nonflammable or noncombustible liquid
hazardous materials stored or displayed in a single control area of a Group M occupancy shall not exceed the quantities in Table
414.2.5(1).
SECTION BC 310
RESIDENTIAL GROUP R
